title: Discover
description: Talks, founder stories and industry visits that help you find a problem worth solving.

title: Idea
description: Shape a real problem, a real customer and a first possible solution.

title: Team
description: Find a cofounder, developer, designer or teammate from inside the club.

title: Validate
description: Test the idea against real customers, competitors and pricing before you build.

title: Build
description: Put together a first working version or prototype with support from mentors.

title: Business
description: Work out the model, the legal structure, the finances and how you will sell.

title: Fund
description: Get warm introductions to competitions, grants, angels and funds through EIC.

title: Launch
description: Register the company, win the first customers and start hiring.
